messages:
Anya Patel: Heads up — we just confirmed a webhook auth regression affecting some new onboarders in EU. Drafting external status note. Need customer-facing wording, credits, and an office hours session. Affected count: ~24 tenants. @Mike Chen can you confirm root cause?
Mike Chen: investigating. Initial: an auth token rotation script ran with a missing service account key, caused 401s for onboarding webhooks. Rolling fix deployed to EU at ~23:22 UTC. Backfilled retry queue; still validating replays.
Sophia Li: Post-deploy metrics look better — 200->2 errors/min. We have list of affected tenants in the customer DB; 24 total, 6 high-touch (dedicated pools). I'll attach list to Zendesk once final.
James Ortega: can we get a short blurb I can send to 3 renewal-risk accounts? Need to limit exec churn. Offer a 2-week credit? Also schedule 1:1 office hours for impacted renewals.
Anya Patel: Draft below — please edit for tone and accuracy:
```
Hi — we wanted to let you know about a recent onboarding interruption that may have caused delays for some tenants.

Root cause: an internal token expired during an automated rotation.
Impact: webhook deliveries for new onboarding flows (EU region) between approx 23:05–23:25 UTC on Mar 18.
Mitigation: we replayed queued events and performed manual backfills where needed; affected accounts should see onboarding complete.
Action for you: no action required; please contact support if you notice missing records or stalled flows.
Compensation: we will apply a one-time service credit and offer office hours for a deeper review.

We apologize for the disruption and are following up with a full RCA. — The Redwood CS Team
```
Mike Chen: small tweaks — change window to 'approx 23:05–23:25 UTC' (done), include exact impacted tenant count (24), and add: 'we've added additional safeguards to token rotation and an automated health-check to prevent recurrence.'
Sophia Li: Suggest adding a link to an office hours RSVP and a dedicated support alias for impacted customers. @Elena Morales can you confirm legal wording for credits/SLA language?
Elena Morales: Legal ok to offer a 'one-time service credit' pending account review. Please avoid promising specific dollar amounts in the public message; route financial details through account managers/CS reps.
Anya Patel: Updated draft with legal note. I'll publish via status.redwood.ai and send tailored emails to the 24 tenants; the 6 high-touch will get a personalized note and offered 1:1 office hours. James you'll get the personalization copy in DM in ~10m.
James Ortega: thanks. Also want to capture structured feedback during office hours — can we include a 3-question form? Sophia, can you create a shared doc? :+1:
Sophia Li: creating doc now, will post link in this thread when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy 1762 succeeded to prod-eu at 23:22 UTC by mike.c
Anya Patel: timeline/RCA will be ready by EOD. For customer comms, planned cadence: 1) public status banner, 2) targeted email to 24 tenants, 3) bespoke outreach to 6 high-touch + credits workflow. Any objections?
Mike Chen: thumbs up. Recommend adding a short 'how we detected this' section in the RCA (monitoring alert => auth failure spike then token rotation trace).
Anya Patel: noted. Publishing status banner in 5m. Will follow up with final RCA, credit allocation process, and the office hours RSVP link. Thanks everyone.
